name: JW Pharmaceutical Corporation
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, JW Pharmaceutical Corporation is a long-standing entity, established in 1945, specializing in the research, production, and global distribution of a comprehensive range of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies. The company's diverse product portfolio serves markets in Japan and numerous other international regions, addressing a broad spectrum of therapeutic areas including cardiovascular health, gastrointestinal and urinary conditions, central nervous system disorders, infectious diseases, women's health, kidney ailments, respiratory issues, oncology, pain management, and critical care nutrition.
